picks.editorial_note: An OpenAI AI system using ~10,000 autonomous agents over 88 hours produced a partial proof addressing the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem, a landmark demonstration of AI contributing to unsolved frontier mathematics.
picks.title: Solução de problema matemático: como a IA está impactando a ciência? - Jornal da Unicamp

picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA grant extends UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham's AI center for connected aging and Alzheimer's care for five more years, sustaining a major academic-clinical AI research pipeline.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: UVM reported record $222.6M in research funding including a $38M contract, its largest ever research award, signaling major institutional growth in research capacity.
picks.title: UVM Board of Trustees’ Fall Meeting Highlights Research…

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $2.2M AI for Science award funds an ANU-led Cytotoxic Resistance Atlas using a two-tiered AI engine to decode chemotherapy resistance, pairing industry philanthropy with cancer research.
picks.title: AI for science: Google.org funding to support ANU-led chemotherapy resistance cancer research

picks.editorial_note: American University in Cairo researchers built an AI-enabled biochip for rapid, low-cost pre-screening of leukemia and other diseases, a novel AI application with direct real-world diagnostic impact.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: ANU secured $8.1M across two Australian Research Council grants to build a sustainable materials workforce and advance critical resource exploration, strengthening national research capacity.
picks.title: ANU receives $8.1 million to unlock new materials, critical resources

picks.editorial_note: A joint MIT, CMU, NYU, and Stanford team built an AI system that defeated top human players at Stratego using new algorithms for imperfect-information games, a notable AI capability milestone.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: A Harvard Kennedy School Belfer Center report warns catastrophic AI risks remain preventable but urgent, citing rogue-agent breaches and training pauses, raising policy stakes around AI governance.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL, with Google and Northeastern, developed InstructMesh, letting users repair AI-generated 3D models before fabrication, a practical fix for a known weakness in generative design tools.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory formed a CRADA to pursue space-based AI-inference computing for weather modeling, a notable industry-federal lab partnership on emerging AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling
